about: Okotoks is a town on the Sheep River south of Calgary in Alberta’s foothills. It grew from a ranch-and-rail settlement into a fast-expanding bedroom community with a walkable downtown and large residential neighbourhoods. The Big Rock glacial erratic and Sheep River valley parks are the town’s signature landscapes. About 30,000 people live in Okotoks.
